title: Conductor Step-Run Record (schemaVersion 1)
description: The record a Review gate renders so a non-engineer can judge what an agent-run Step produced (COND-18 P0-6). Because skill Steps run LOCALLY (Claude Code drives, the backend does not), this record is REPORTED BY THE SKILL THROUGH MCP, not materialized by the automation engine's WorkflowRun. It captures: what the agent was asked to do, what it produced (rendered naturally), an optional before/after, and any flags — the context that defeats 'approval theater'.

id.description: Stable id of this step-run, used as the Review's resume/reference handle.

workflow.description: Workflow definition id (slug) the Work Item runs on.

transition.description: The transition this Step ran on; the gate holds the move to `to` until the Review resolves.

skill.description: For kind=skill: the skill id that ran (e.g. conductor:implement).

status.description: Lifecycle of the step-run. AWAITING_REVIEW means it produced its artifact and the gate is now held for a human.

inputBrief.description: Plain-language statement of WHAT THE AGENT WAS ASKED TO DO — rendered first at the gate (P0-6 (1)).

produced.description: What the Step produced, rendered naturally (P0-6 (2)): Documents edited and Assets recorded. Type-aware rendering keys off `kind` (a content asset shows the readable output; a github_pr shows the diff).

ref.description: Document filename/id or Asset ref (url or file reference).

assetType.description: For kind=asset: the asset type (e.g. github_pr, published_url).

beforeAfter.description: Optional before/after where the Step edited existing content (P0-6 (3)).

flags.description: Why it's here / anything ambiguous the reviewer should weigh (P0-6 (4)). e.g. 'market sizing was ambiguous'.

reportedBy.description: Identity that ran the local skill and reported this record via MCP (attribution for the audit log).
